account:
Today I reviewed my appointment book and attended my morning office appointment. The secretary reported no new council letters or requests. I have now arrived at the mill for the scheduled ten o'clock grain inspection, but I have not seen the miller. Both the secretary and baker said earlier that they had looked for the miller without finding him; that does not establish why he is absent. The secretary asked freight and the neighbour to relay my request for grain stocks and delivery records.

The unusual thing I have just heard is two townsfolk near the mill saying, 'bridge or port change at bakery.' I do not yet know what change they mean, whether anything actually happened, or where that report began. I have asked Townsfolk 11 for the specific report and its source, as well as whether anyone has seen the miller. Yesterday and this morning I had no confirmed damage or infrastructure changes to announce, and I have authorized neither repairs nor paid inspections. The builder agreed not to incur costs without an agreement. These fragments may be circulating news or a misunderstanding, but I have no evidence of their purpose or of any organized activity.

The baker has been asking about confirmed gatherings needing bread. Neither I nor the secretary knows of any public gathering or bread order; my three o'clock tea with the neighbour is private. The neighbour has offered to direct bread customers to the baker's stall. For now I see ordinary business and conversation alongside an unverified report that needs clarification.
